items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I'll stand all day and tell you, all night, that Nestor did not get that money.

ctx.x: The money was gone, but the reason I knew Nestor didn't get it, Nestor never showed up out there after he left that night, see? Nestor never showed. But I did know this guitar player, he kept telling me, he says, "Mack, let's go." I said, "Go where?" "Let's go to Oklahoma City." I said, "Man, I ain't got but $30 in the bank and I ain't going to --" in the post office -- and I says, "--and I ain't going to take that out and pay my way to Oklahoma City when I got a job to do on here. He says, "You don't have to pay…

So the old man, he come over and sit and talk, says, "Well, who do you think got the money?" Well, this guitar player and a couple of other guys, they went on back. We stayed, see? So I just told him, "No, Nestor didn't get it. I'll stand all day and tell you, all night, that Nestor did not get that money." I says, "Now, the other guys, they're gone. But I know Nestor didn't do it."

So anyway, the old man, he told me, "I'm hurt. I'm hurt. I've never felt like this in my life," and so on and so on and the old man went in the bathroom and blew his brains out. I said, "Well, I done seen everything now." One,
